rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 103 [2023] of the General Administration of Customs - Announcement on Completely Suspending the IMPORT of Aquatic Products from Japan
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2023年第103号（关于全面暂停进口日本水产品的公告）
rows.description: In order to comprehensively prevent the radioactive contamination risks to food safety caused by the discharge of nuclear contaminated water from Fukushima, Japan, protect the health of Chinese consumers, and ensure the safety of imported food, the General Administration of Customs has decided to fully suspend the import of aquatic products (including edible aquatic animals) originating from Japan, effective from August 24, 2023 (inclusive). This decision is based on the relevant provisions of the Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China and its implementation regulations, the Administrative Measures for the Import and Export Food Safety of the People's Republic of China, and the relevant provisions of the World Trade Organization's Agreement on the Application of Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 为全面防范日本福岛核污染水排海对食品安全造成的放射性污染风险，保护中国消费者健康，确保进口食品安全，依据《中华人民共和国食品安全法》及其实施条例、《中华人民共和国进出口食品安全管理办法》有关规定，以及世界贸易组织《实施卫生与植物卫生措施协定》有关规定，海关总署决定自2023年8月24日（含）起全面暂停进口原产地为日本的水产品（含食用水生动物）。

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 12 [2020] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on phytosanitary requirements for IMPORTed fresh melons from Brazil
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2020年第12号（关于进口巴西鲜食甜瓜植物检疫要求的公告）
rows.description: According to relevant laws and regulations of my country and the "Protocol on Plant Quarantine Requirements for the Export of Brazilian Melons to China between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food Supply of the Federative Republic of Brazil", from the date of this announcement, Brazilian melons that meet the relevant requirements are allowed to be imported. The plant quarantine requirements for imported fresh melons from Brazil are now announced.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与巴西联邦共和国农业、畜牧和食品供应部关于巴西甜瓜输华植物检疫要求的议定书》规定，自本公告发布之日起，允许符合相关要求的巴西甜瓜进口。现将进口巴西鲜食甜瓜植物检疫要求予以公布。
rows.symbol: 海关总署公告2020 年第12号

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 123 [2018] of the General Administration of Customs and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs—Announcement on Preventing the Swine Fever Epidemic in Japan from Spreading into China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署、农业农村部公告2018年第123号—关于防止日本猪瘟疫情传入我国的公告
rows.description: On September 9, 2018, an outbreak of classical swine fever was reported in Gifu Prefecture, Japan. For the purpose of protecting the safety of China's animal husbandry and preventing the epidemic from entering China, in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Quarantine of Imported and Exported Animals and Plants and other relevant laws and regulations, this Announcement is hereby issued as follows:
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2018年9月9日，日本岐阜县发生1起古典猪瘟疫情。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下：
rows.documentation: CHN_海关总署 农业农村部公告2018年第123号（关于防止日本猪瘟疫情传入我国）.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 126 [2018] of the General Administration of Customs and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs—Announcement on Preventing African Swine Fever in Bulgaria from Spreading into China

rows.description: On August 31, Bulgaria issued an immediate notification to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) of an outbreak of African swine fever in Varna, Bulgaria. For the purposes of protecting the safety of China's animal husbandry and preventing the epidemic from entering China, in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Quarantine of Imported and Exported Animals and Plants and other relevant laws and regulations, this Announcement is hereby issued as follows:
rows.descriptionOriginal: 8月31日，保加利亚官方向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急通报，保加利亚瓦尔纳州（Varna）发生1起野猪非洲猪瘟疫情。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下：
rows.documentation: CHN_海关总署 农业农村部公告2018年第126号（关于防止保加利亚非洲猪瘟传入我国）.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 133 [2018] of the General Administration of Customs and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs―Announcement on Preventing African Swine Fever from Spreading to China from Moldova
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署、农业农村部公告2018年第133号—关于防止摩尔多瓦非洲猪瘟传入我国的公告
rows.description: On September 21, Moldova gave an urgent notification to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that there had been five outbreaks of African swine fever in the country. For purpose of protecting the safety of China's animal husbandry and preventing the epidemic from entering China, in accordance with the provisions of the Customs Law of the People's Republic of China and the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Quarantine of Imported and Exported Animals and Plants and other relevant laws and regulations, this Announcement is hereby issued as follows:
rows.descriptionOriginal: 9月21日，摩尔多瓦官方向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急通报，近日该国境内发生5起非洲猪瘟疫情。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下：
rows.documentation: CHN_海关总署 农业农村部公告2018年第133号（关于防止摩尔多瓦非洲猪瘟传入我国的公告）.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 2 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for Imported Beef from Belarus
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第2号（关于进口白俄罗斯牛肉检验检疫要求的公告 ）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of China and the "Agreement on the Inspection, Quarantine, and Veterinary Sanitary Requirements for the Export of Beef and Its Products from the Republic of Belarus to China" between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture and Food of the Republic of Belarus, beef and its products from Belarus that meet the relevant requirements are allowed for import. The inspection and quarantine requirements for the import of beef and its products from Belarus to China are hereby announced (see attachment).
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署和白俄罗斯共和国农业和食品部关于白俄罗斯输华牛肉及其制品的检验检疫和兽医卫生要求议定书》的规定，允许符合相关要求的白俄罗斯牛肉及其制品进口。现将中国进口白俄罗斯牛肉及其制品检验检疫要求予以公布（见附件）。

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 206 [2018] of the General Administration of Customs—Announcement on Resuming the Import of Ukraine's Poultry and Poultry Products
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2018年第206号—关于恢复进口乌克兰禽类及其产品的公告
rows.description: Based on the results of the risk analysis, the import of Ukraine's poultry and poultry products that comply with China's relevant inspection and quarantine requirements shall be resumed on the date of issuance of this Announcement, upon which the Urgent Notice of Suspending the Import of Poultry and Poultry Products from Ukraine (No. 107 [2005], General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine) shall be repealed.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据风险分析结果，自本公告发布之日起，恢复符合中国相关检验检疫要求的乌克兰禽类及其产品进口。《关于暂停从乌克兰进口禽类及其产品的紧急通知》（国质检明发〔2005〕107号）同时废止。

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 35 [2018] of the General Administration of Customs and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs―Announcement on Preventing African Swine Fever in Hungary from Spreading into China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署、农业农村部公告2018年第35号—关于防止匈牙利非洲猪瘟传入我国的公告
rows.description: On April 23, the Ministry of Agriculture of Hungary filed an urgent report with OIE on the outbreak of one case of African swine fever on wild boars in Heves, Hungary on April 20. For the purposes of protecting the safety of China's animal husbandry and preventing the epidemic from entering China, according to the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Quarantine of Imported and Exported Animals and Plants and other relevant laws and regulations, this Announcement is hereby issued as follows:
rows.descriptionOriginal: 4月23日，匈牙利农业部向OIE紧急报告，匈牙利赫维什州（Heves）于4月20日发生1起野猪非洲猪瘟疫情。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下：

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 4 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza from Slovenia to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第4号（关于防止斯洛文尼亚高致病性禽流感传入我国的公告）
rows.description: Recently, the official authorities of Slovenia reported to the World Organization for Animal Health that an H5N1 subtype highly pathogenic avian influenza epidemic occurred in the domestic poultry of their country. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 近日，斯洛文尼亚官方向世界动物卫生组织通报本国家禽发生H5N1亚型高致病性禽流感疫情。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下

General Administration of Customs
Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Areas

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 5 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of Foot-and-Mouth Disease from Palestine to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第5号（关于防止巴勒斯坦口蹄疫传入我国的公告）
rows.description: On December 15, 2021, Palestine urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that a foot-and-mouth disease outbreak occurred at a farm in Tubas province, West Bank region, involving 172 susceptible animals, goats, and sheep, among which 40 were sick and 5 died. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2021年12月15日，巴勒斯坦向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国约旦河西岸地区图巴斯省的1家农场发生口蹄疫疫情，血清型待鉴定。涉及的易感动物为172只山羊和绵羊，其中40只发病，5只死亡。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.agencies: General Administration of Customs and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
rows.documentation: CHN_119.海关总署 农业农村部关于防止巴勒斯坦口蹄疫传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.description: In April 2019, the customs of China and Uruguay officially signed the "Arrangement on the Mutual Recognition of the China Customs Enterprise Credit Management System and the Uruguay Customs AEO System" (hereinafter referred to as the "Mutual Recognition Arrangement"), and decided to officially implement it from January 26, 2022. The following announcement is made on the relevant matters.

The phytosanitary requirements for the import of fresh pears from South Africa are hereby announced (see attachment).
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与南非共和国农业、土地改革和农村发展部关于南非鲜梨输华植物检疫要求的议定书》规定，自本公告发布之日起，允许符合相关要求的南非鲜梨进口。现将进口南非鲜梨植物检疫要求予以公布（见附件）。

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 9 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of African swine fever from Italy and North Macedonia to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第9号（关于防止意大利、北马其顿非洲猪瘟传入我国的公告）
rows.description: On January 8, 2022, Italy urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) an African Swine Fever incident on January 5 in Alessandria, Piedmont, involving a susceptible animal, a wild boar, which became ill and died. On January 10, 2022, North Macedonia urgently reported to the OIE an African Swine Fever outbreak on December 29, 2021, in the Delčevo region, involving 18 susceptible domestic pigs, among which 3 were sick and 15 died. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2022年1月8日，意大利向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国皮埃蒙特大区亚历山德里亚省（Alessandria，Piemonte）1月5日发生1起非洲猪瘟，涉及易感动物为野猪，1头野猪发病死亡。2022年1月10日，北马其顿向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国代尔切沃地区（Delčevo）2021年12月29日发生1起非洲猪瘟，涉及易感动物为18头家猪，其中3头发病，15头死亡。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.agencies: General Administration of Customs and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 99, 2018 of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the General Administration of Customs (Announcement on Preventing the Introduction of Bulgarian PPR into Our Country)
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2018年第99号（关于防止保加利亚小反刍兽疫传入我国的公告）
rows.description: The Bulgarian Ministry of Agriculture and Food has urgently notified the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) of an outbreak of PPR involving 160 goats and 380 sheep in Jambol Prefecture. The diagnosis is laboratory tested and is the first of its kind in Bulgaria. In order to protect the safety of our country's animal husbandry industry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine and other relevant laws and regulations, the following announcement is hereby made:
rows.descriptionOriginal: 近日，保加利亚农业和食品部向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急通报，扬博尔州（Jambol）发生1起小反刍兽疫疫情，涉及160只山羊和380只绵羊，诊断性质为实验室检测，此次疫情为保加利亚首次发生。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下：
rows.agencies: The General Administration of Customs, The Ministry of Agriculture and Rual Areas

rows.officialTitle: General Administration of Customs — Announcement on Carrying Out Random Inspection of Import and Export Commodities Outside the Catalogue of Commodities Subject to Statutory Inspection
rows.description:
To protect the legitimate rights and interests of consumers and safeguard the lives, health, and safety of the people, and in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Import and Export Commodity Inspection" and its implementing regulations, the General Administration of Customs has decided to implement spot checks on certain import and export commodities outside the statutory inspection catalogue, effective from the date of this announcement. The scope of these spot checks is attached.

　　The random inspection and testing work shall be carried out in accordance with the "Administrative Measures for Random Inspection and Testing of Import and Export Commodities" (promulgated by Order No. 39 of the former General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and revised by Order No. 263 of the General Administration of Customs).

　　After the release of this announcement, General Administration of Customs Announcement No. 132 of 2019, No. 95 of 2020, No. 60 of 2021 and No. 60 of 2022 will be repealed.

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 11 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs- Announcement on preventing the spread of African swine fever from Thailand to China

rows.description: On January 14, 2022, Thailand urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that an African Swine Fever occurred in a village of Bangkok Metropolis, involving 3 pet pigs that were all sick and died. Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Areas

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 30 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of Foot-and-Mouth Disease from South Africa to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第30号（关于防止南非口蹄疫传入我国的公告）
rows.description: On March 21, 2022, South Africa urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that a foot-and-mouth disease (South African Type 2, SAT 2) occurred on a farm in the North West province on March 2, involving 1600 cattle, among which 1100 cattle were sick, and the epidemic site was located in the previously recognized foot-and-mouth disease non-immune disease-free zone of our country. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2022年3月21日，南非向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国西北省（North West）1家农场于3月2日发生口蹄疫（南非2型，SAT 2），涉及1600头牛，其中1100头牛发病，疫点位于此前我国认可的口蹄疫非免疫无疫区内。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.documentation: CHN_95.海关总署 农业农村部关于防止南非口蹄疫传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.description: In accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Free Trade Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Korea" and the resolution of the Joint Committee, the limit of up to 20 items of the certificate of origin for import and export goods under the agreement is canceled, and the certificate format is implemented according to the attachment.

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 34 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for Imported Wild Aquatic Products from Kenya
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第34号（关于进口肯尼亚野生水产品检验检疫要求的公告）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of China and the "Agreement on the Inspection, Quarantine, and Veterinary Sanitary Requirements for the Export of Wild Aquatic Products from the Republic of Kenya to China" between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries, and Cooperatives of the Republic of Kenya, starting from the date of publication of this announcement, the import of wild aquatic products from Kenya that meet the relevant requirements is allowed. The "Import Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for Wild Aquatic Products from Kenya" (see attachment) are hereby announced.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与肯尼亚共和国农业、畜牧业、渔业和合作部关于肯尼亚输华野生水产品的检验检疫和兽医卫生要求议定书》规定，自本公告发布之日起，允许符合相关要求的肯尼亚野生水产品进口。现将《进口肯尼亚野生水产品检验检疫要求》（见附件）予以公布。

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 38 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of sheeppox and goatpox from Mongolia to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第38号（关于防止蒙古绵羊痘和山羊痘传入我国的公告）
rows.description: On April 23, 2022, Mongolia urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that from April 11 to 12, sheeppox and goatpox occurred in one farm each in Hentiy Province, Dornod Province, and Sükhbaatar Province, involving 2747 sheep, among which 95 were sick and 13 died. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2022年4月23日，蒙古向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，4月11日至12日，该国肯特省（Hentiy）、东方省（Dornod）、苏赫巴托尔省（Sühbaatar）各1家农场发生绵羊痘和山羊痘，涉及2747只绵羊，其中95只发病，死亡13只。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.agencies: General Administration of Customs and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
rows.documentation: CHN_87.海关总署 农业农村部关于防止蒙古绵羊痘和山羊痘传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 40 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of cholera epidemic to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第40号（关于防止霍乱疫情传入我国的公告）
rows.description: According to the notification from the World Health Organization (WHO), there were outbreaks of cholera in Malawi, Benin, and Cameroon. To prevent the spread of the cholera epidemic in Malawi, Benin, and Cameroon to our country and to protect the health and safety of people entering and exiting the country, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Frontier Health and Quarantine" and its implementation rules and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据世界卫生组织（WHO）通报，马拉维、贝宁、喀麦隆暴发霍乱疫情。为防止马拉维、贝宁、喀麦隆霍乱疫情传入我国，保护出入境人员的健康安全，根据《中华人民共和国国境卫生检疫法》及其实施细则等法律法规的规定，现发布公告如下
rows.documentation: CHN_85.海关总署关于防止霍乱疫情传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Foreign Trade Policy, 2023
rows.description:
Foreign Trade Policy (2023) is a policy document which is based on continuity of time-tested schemes facilitating exports as well as a document which is nimble and responsive to the requirements of trade. It is based on principles of ‘trust’ and ‘partnership’ with exporters. 

The FTP 2023 aims at process re-engineering and automation to facilitate ease of doing business for exporters. It also focuses on emerging areas like dual use high end technology items under SCOMET, facilitating e-commerce export, collaborating with States and Districts for export promotion.

rows.officialTitle: The Antiquities and Art Treasures Act, 1972

An Act to regulate the export trade in antiquities and art treasures, to provide for the prevention of smuggling of, and fraudulent dealings in, antiquities, to provide for the compulsory acquisition of antiquities and art treasures for preservation in public places and to provide for certain other matters connected therewith or incidental or ancillary thereto.

It repeals the Antiquities (Export Control) Act, 1947.

Knowledge and Benefits Sharing Regulations, 2014.
rows.description: The objective of the Guidelines on Access to Biological Resources and Associated Knowledge and Benefits Sharing Regulations, 2014 is to regulate the access to biological resources and traditional knowledge in India, ensuring that such access is granted with prior informed consent and based on mutually agreed terms. The guidelines also aim to ensure the fair and equitable sharing of benefits derived from the utilization of these resources and knowledge, in compliance with national and international legal frameworks such as the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD).
rows.source: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
rows.documentation: IND_Guidelines on Access to Biological Resources 2014.pdf

rows.officialTitle: National Seeds Policy, 2002
rows.description: The objective of the National Seeds Policy 2002 of India is to ensure the production and availability of quality seeds in sufficient quantity at affordable prices for farmers.
rows.source: MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE

rows.officialTitle: New Policy on seed development, 1988
rows.description: The New Policy on Seed Development, 1988 in India was formulated with the primary objective of promoting the production, quality control, and availability of high-quality seeds for agricultural growth, which is essential for the country's food security and economic development.
rows.source: MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE

rows.description: This Order seeks to establish standards and quality control measures for the production and use of HDPE and PP woven sacks used for packaging 25 kg polymer materials. This ensures the sacks are durable, safe, and protect the polymer products during handling, storage, and transportation.

rows.officialTitle: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002
rows.description:
An Act to provide for conservation of Biological Diversity, sustainable use of its
components and fair and equitable sharing of the benefits arising out of the use of biological
resources, knowledge and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto
rows.source: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

rows.officialTitle: The Biological Diversity Rules, 2024
rows.description: The objective of The Biological Diversity Rules, 2024 is to regulate access to biological resources and traditional knowledge, ensuring their conservation, sustainable use, and fair sharing of benefits in accordance with the Biological Diversity Act, 2002, and international agreements like the Nagoya Protocol.
rows.source: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

rows.officialTitle: The Cable Television Networks (Amendment) Rules, 2021.
rows.description: The Cable Television Networks (Amendment) Rules, 2021, introduced by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, primarily aim to establish a robust grievance redressal system for cable television broadcasts by implementing a three-tier mechanism: self-regulation by broadcasters, oversight by their self-regulating bodies, and a final review by an Inter-Departmental Committee at the government level, ultimately holding broadcasters accountable for content violations and ensuring transparency in the process.
rows.source: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting
rows.agencies: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting

rows.officialTitle: the Cable Television Networks (Regulation) Act, 1995.
rows.description: The Cable Television Networks (Regulation) Act, 1995 regulates cable TV networks in India by ensuring orderly operation, content standards, and the registration of cable operators. It aims to control harmful content, regulate foreign broadcasts, and establish a framework for the growth of cable TV services.
rows.source: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting
rows.agencies: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting

rows.officialTitle: The Coir Industry Act, 1953
rows.description:
An Act to provide for the establishment of a Board for the development of the Coir Industry and for that purpose to levy customs duty on coir fiber, coir yarn and coir products exported from India and for matters connected therewith.

Implemented vide notification No. S.R.O. 470, dated 9th February, 1954.
rows.source: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)

rows.officialTitle: The Cosmetics Rules, 2020
rows.description: The objective of the Cosmetics Rules, 2020 is to regulate the manufacture, sale, and import of cosmetics in India to ensure their safety, quality, and effectiveness. The rules aim to protect consumer health by establishing standards for cosmetic products, labeling, packaging, and testing, while promoting transparency and compliance within the industry.
rows.source: Ministry of Family and Health Affairs

rows.officialTitle: The Export (Quality Control and Inspection) Act, 1963
rows.description:
An Act to provide for the sound development of the export trade of India through quality control and inspection and for matters connected therewith.

(No. 40 of 1984)

rows.officialTitle: The Export (Quality Control and Inspection) Rules, 1964.
rows.description: The objective of the Export (Quality Control and Inspection) Rules, 1964 is to ensure that goods intended for export from India meet specified quality standards. rows.officialTitle: The New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019
rows.description: The objective of the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019 is to regulate the approval, import, and clinical trials of new drugs in India. rows.officialTitle: The Offshore Areas Mineral Conservation and Development Rules, 2024
rows.description: The Offshore Areas Mineral Conservation and Development Rules, 2024 aim to ensure the sustainable exploration and extraction of offshore mineral resources, focusing on conservation, environmental protection, and safety. rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 103 [2023] of the General Administration of Customs - Announcement on Completely Suspending the IMPORT of Aquatic Products from Japan
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2023年第103号（关于全面暂停进口日本水产品的公告）
rows.description: In order to comprehensively prevent the radioactive contamination risks to food safety caused by the discharge of nuclear contaminated water from Fukushima, Japan, protect the health of Chinese consumers, and ensure the safety of imported food, the General Administration of Customs has decided to fully suspend the import of aquatic products (including edible aquatic animals) originating from Japan, effective from August 24, 2023 (inclusive). This decision is based on the relevant provisions of the Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China and its implementation regulations, the Administrative Measures for the Import and Export Food Safety of the People's Republic of China, and the relevant provisions of the World Trade Organization's Agreement on the Application of Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 为全面防范日本福岛核污染水排海对食品安全造成的放射性污染风险，保护中国消费者健康，确保进口食品安全，依据《中华人民共和国食品安全法》及其实施条例、《中华人民共和国进出口食品安全管理办法》有关规定，以及世界贸易组织《实施卫生与植物卫生措施协定》有关规定，海关总署决定自2023年8月24日（含）起全面暂停进口原产地为日本的水产品（含食用水生动物）。

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 12 [2020] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on phytosanitary requirements for IMPORTed fresh melons from Brazil
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2020年第12号（关于进口巴西鲜食甜瓜植物检疫要求的公告）
rows.description: According to relevant laws and regulations of my country and the "Protocol on Plant Quarantine Requirements for the Export of Brazilian Melons to China between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food Supply of the Federative Republic of Brazil", from the date of this announcement, Brazilian melons that meet the relevant requirements are allowed to be imported. The plant quarantine requirements for imported fresh melons from Brazil are now announced.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与巴西联邦共和国农业、畜牧和食品供应部关于巴西甜瓜输华植物检疫要求的议定书》规定，自本公告发布之日起，允许符合相关要求的巴西甜瓜进口。现将进口巴西鲜食甜瓜植物检疫要求予以公布。
rows.symbol: 海关总署公告2020 年第12号

rows.description: On December 15, 2021, Palestine urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that a foot-and-mouth disease outbreak occurred at a farm in Tubas province, West Bank region, involving 172 susceptible animals, goats, and sheep, among which 40 were sick and 5 died. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.

rows.description: On January 8, 2022, Italy urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) an African Swine Fever incident on January 5 in Alessandria, Piedmont, involving a susceptible animal, a wild boar, which became ill and died. On January 10, 2022, North Macedonia urgently reported to the OIE an African Swine Fever outbreak on December 29, 2021, in the Delčevo region, involving 18 susceptible domestic pigs, among which 3 were sick and 15 died. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2022年1月8日，意大利向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国皮埃蒙特大区亚历山德里亚省（Alessandria，Piemonte）1月5日发生1起非洲猪瘟，涉及易感动物为野猪，1头野猪发病死亡。2022年1月10日，北马其顿向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国代尔切沃地区（Delčevo）2021年12月29日发生1起非洲猪瘟，涉及易感动物为18头家猪，其中3头发病，15头死亡。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下

rows.description: The Bulgarian Ministry of Agriculture and Food has urgently notified the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) of an outbreak of PPR involving 160 goats and 380 sheep in Jambol Prefecture. The diagnosis is laboratory tested and is the first of its kind in Bulgaria. In order to protect the safety of our country's animal husbandry industry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine and other relevant laws and regulations, the following announcement is hereby made:
rows.descriptionOriginal: 近日，保加利亚农业和食品部向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急通报，扬博尔州（Jambol）发生1起小反刍兽疫疫情，涉及160只山羊和380只绵羊，诊断性质为实验室检测，此次疫情为保加利亚首次发生。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下：

rows.officialTitle: General Administration of Customs — Announcement on Carrying Out Random Inspection of Import and Export Commodities Outside the Catalogue of Commodities Subject to Statutory Inspection
rows.description:
To protect the legitimate rights and interests of consumers and safeguard the lives, health, and safety of the people, and in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Import and Export Commodity Inspection" and its implementing regulations, the General Administration of Customs has decided to implement spot checks on certain import and export commodities outside the statutory inspection catalogue, effective from the date of this announcement. The scope of these spot checks is attached.

　　The random inspection and testing work shall be carried out in accordance with the "Administrative Measures for Random Inspection and Testing of Import and Export Commodities" (promulgated by Order No. 39 of the former General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and revised by Order No. 263 of the General Administration of Customs).

　　After the release of this announcement, General Administration of Customs Announcement No. 132 of 2019, No. 95 of 2020, No. 60 of 2021 and No. 60 of 2022 will be repealed.

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 14 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs- Announcement on the triggering level quantity of two types of agricultural products imported from Australia in 2022
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第14号（关于2022年自澳大利亚进口两类农产品触发水平数量的公告 ）
rows.description: In accordance with the "Free Trade Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of Australia" and the GACC Announcement No. 207 of 2019 (Announcement on Issues Related to the Implementation of Special Safeguard Measures for Imported Agricultural Products under the Free Trade Agreement), China implements special safeguard measures for two categories of eight tariff code agricultural products imported from Australia (hereinafter referred to as the two types of agricultural products). The quantities of the two types of agricultural products imported at the agreed tariff rates for 2021 and the import trigger levels for 2022 are hereby announced (see attachment).
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据《中华人民共和国政府和澳大利亚政府自由贸易协定》和海关总署公告2019年第207号（关于自由贸易协定项下进口农产品实施特殊保障措施有关问题的公告），我国对自澳大利亚进口的两类8个税号农产品（以下简称两类农产品）实施特殊保障措施。现将2021年度两类农产品适用协定税率进口数量和2022年度进口触发水平数量予以公布（见附件）。
rows.documentation: CHN_110.海关总署关于2022年自澳大利亚进口两类农产品触发水平数量的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 15 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs- Announcement on preventing the spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza from Spain and Moldova to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第15号（关于防止西班牙、摩尔多瓦高致病性禽流感传入我国的公告）
rows.description: Recently, the official authorities of Spain and Moldova reported to the World Organization for Animal Health that an H5N1 subtype highly pathogenic avian influenza epidemic occurred in the domestic poultry of their countries. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 近日，西班牙和摩尔多瓦官方向世界动物卫生组织通报本国家禽发生H5N1亚型高致病性禽流感疫情。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.agencies: General Administration of Customs and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
rows.documentation: CHN_109.海关总署 农业农村部关于防止西班牙、摩尔多瓦高致病性禽流感传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 16 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs—Announcement on Implementing the Mutual Recognition of “Authorized Economic Operators (AEO)” between the Customs Authorities of China and the United Arab Emirates
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第16号（关于实施中国-阿联酋海关“经认证的经营者”（AEO）互认的公告 ）
rows.description: In July 2019, the customs of China and the United Arab Emirates officially signed the "Arrangement on the Mutual Recognition of the China Customs Enterprise Credit Management System and the UAE Customs 'Authorized Economic Operator' System" (hereinafter referred to as the "Mutual Recognition Arrangement"), and decided to officially implement it from February 14, 2022. The following announcement is made on the relevant matters.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2019年7月，中国与阿联酋双方海关正式签署了《中华人民共和国海关总署和阿拉伯联合酋长国联邦海关署关于中国海关企业信用管理制度与阿联酋海关“经认证的经营者”制度互认的安排》（以下简称《互认安排》），决定自2022年2月14日起正式实施。现就有关事项公告如下
rows.documentation: CHN_108.海关总署关于实施中国—阿联酋海关“经认证的经营者”（AEO）互认的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 17 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on inspection and quarantine requirements for imported mutton from Chile
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第17号（关于进口智利羊肉检验检疫要求的公告）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of China and the "Agreement on the Inspection, Quarantine, and Veterinary Sanitary Requirements for the Import of Lamb and Mutton from Chile to China" between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture of the Republic of Chile, lamb and mutton from Chile that meet the relevant requirements are allowed for import. The inspection and quarantine requirements for the import of Chilean lamb and mutton to China are hereby announced (see attachment).
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署和智利共和国农业部关于中国从智利输入绵羊和山羊肉的检验检疫和兽医卫生要求议定书》的规定，允许符合相关要求的智利羊肉进口。现将中国进口智利羊肉检验检疫要求予以公布（见附件）。
rows.documentation: CHN_107.海关总署关于进口智利羊肉检验检疫要求的公告.pdf | CHN_2022022208313561661.doc

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 18 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for Imported Beef from Chile
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第18号（关于进口智利牛肉检验检疫要求的公告）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of China and the "Agreement on the Inspection, Quarantine, and Veterinary Sanitary Requirements for the Import of Beef from Chile to China" between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture of the Republic of Chile, Chilean beef that meets the relevant requirements is allowed for import. The inspection and quarantine requirements for the import of Chilean beef to China are hereby announced (see attachment).
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署和智利共和国农业部关于中国从智利输入牛肉的检验检疫和兽医卫生要求议定书》的规定，允许符合相关要求的智利牛肉进口。现将中国进口智利牛肉检验检疫要求予以公布（见附件）。
rows.documentation: CHN_106.海关总署关于进口智利牛肉检验检疫要求的公告.pdf | CHN_2022022208313561661_1.doc

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 19 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on phytosanitary requirements for imported corn from Myanmar
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第19号（关于进口缅甸玉米植物检疫要求的公告）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of China and the "Agreement on the Phytosanitary Requirements for the Export of Corn from the Republic of the Union of Myanmar to China" between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, and Irrigation of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, starting from the date of publication of this announcement, the import of Burmese corn that meets the relevant requirements is allowed. The specific phytosanitary requirements are hereby announced (see attachment).
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与缅甸联邦共和国农业、畜牧和灌溉部关于缅甸玉米输往中国植物检疫要求议定书》规定，自本公告发布之日起，允许符合相关要求的缅甸玉米进口。现将具体植物检疫要求予以公布（见附件）。
rows.documentation: CHN_105.海关总署关于进口缅甸玉米植物检疫要求的公告.pdf | CHN_2022022208403739469.doc

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 20 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza from Canada to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第20号（关于防止加拿大高致病性禽流感传入我国的公告）
rows.description: On February 5, 2022, Canada reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that an H5N1 subtype highly pathogenic avian influenza occurred on January 30 at a turkey farm in the country. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2022年2月5日，加拿大向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）报告，该国1家火鸡养殖场1月30日发生1起H5N1亚型高致病性禽流感。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.agencies: General Administration of Customs and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
rows.documentation: CHN_104.海关总署 农业农村部关于防止加拿大高致病性禽流感传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 21 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on allowing wheat imports from all parts of Russia
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第21号（关于允许俄罗斯全境小麦进口的公告）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of China and the "Supplementary Provisions to the Protocol on the Phytosanitary Requirements for the Export of Russian Wheat to China" between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture of the Russian Federation, the import of wheat from all regions of Russia is allowed. The following announcement is made on the relevant matters.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与俄罗斯联邦农业部关于〈俄罗斯输华小麦植物检疫要求议定书〉补充条款》的规定，允许俄罗斯全境小麦进口。现将有关事项公告如下
rows.documentation: CHN_103.海关总署关于允许俄罗斯全境小麦进口的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 23 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for Imported Dairy Products from Mongolia
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第23号（关于进口蒙古国乳品检验检疫要求的公告 ）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of China and the "Protocol on the Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for the Export of Mongolian Dairy Products to China" between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the General Department of Customs of Mongolia, the import of Mongolian dairy products that meet the inspection and quarantine requirements is allowed. The inspection and quarantine requirements for the import of Mongolian dairy products are hereby announced (see attachment).
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与蒙古国海关总局关于蒙古国输华乳品检验检疫要求议定书》的规定，允许符合检验检疫要求的蒙古国乳品进口。现将进口蒙古国乳品检验检疫要求予以公布（见附件）。
rows.documentation: CHN_101.海关总署关于进口蒙古国乳品检验检疫要求的公告.pdf | CHN_2022031010011276714.doc

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 26 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs—Announcement on Issuing the Table of Correspondence between the Inspection and Quarantine Names of Special Goods and Their H.S. Codes
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第26号（关于公布《特殊物品海关检验检疫名称和商品编号对应名录》的公告）
rows.description: To safeguard China's biosecurity and further strengthen the supervision and inspection and quarantine of special items entering and exiting the country, in accordance with the "Biosecurity Law of the People's Republic of China", "Frontier Health and Quarantine Law of the People's Republic of China", its implementation rules, and the "Import and Export Tax Code of the People's Republic of China (2022)", the General Administration of Customs has formulated the "Customs Inspection and Quarantine Name and Commodity Code Corresponding Catalogue for Special Items" (see attachment), which is hereby announced.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 为保障我国生物安全，进一步加强出入境特殊物品卫生检疫监管，根据《中华人民共和国生物安全法》《中华人民共和国国境卫生检疫法》及其实施细则规定和《中华人民共和国进出口税则（2022）》，海关总署制定了《特殊物品海关检验检疫名称和商品编号对应名录》（见附件），现予以公布。
rows.documentation: CHN_99.海关总署关于公布《特殊物品海关检验检疫名称和商品编号对应名录》的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 28 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for Imported Dried Konjac Slices from Indonesia
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第28号（关于进口印度尼西亚魔芋干片检验检疫要求的公告）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of China and the "Agreement on the Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for the Export of Indonesian Konjac Dry Slices to China" between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture of the Republic of Indonesia, it is permitted to import Indonesian konjac dry slices that are produced from the date of publication of this announcement and meet the inspection and quarantine requirements. The inspection and quarantine requirements for the import of Indonesian konjac dry slices are hereby announced (for details, see the attachment).
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与印度尼西亚共和国农业部关于印度尼西亚魔芋干片输华检验检疫要求议定书》规定，允许自本公告发布之日起生产的、符合检验检疫要求的印度尼西亚魔芋干片进口。现将进口印度尼西亚魔芋干片检验检疫要求（详见附件）予以公布。
rows.documentation: CHN_2022033011575826429.doc | CHN_97.海关总署关于进口印度尼西亚魔芋干片检验检疫要求的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 30 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of Foot-and-Mouth Disease from South Africa to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第30号（关于防止南非口蹄疫传入我国的公告）
rows.description: On March 21, 2022, South Africa urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that a foot-and-mouth disease (South African Type 2, SAT 2) occurred on a farm in the North West province on March 2, involving 1600 cattle, among which 1100 cattle were sick, and the epidemic site was located in the previously recognized foot-and-mouth disease non-immune disease-free zone of our country. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2022年3月21日，南非向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国西北省（North West）1家农场于3月2日发生口蹄疫（南非2型，SAT 2），涉及1600头牛，其中1100头牛发病，疫点位于此前我国认可的口蹄疫非免疫无疫区内。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.documentation: CHN_95.海关总署 农业农村部关于防止南非口蹄疫传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 32 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs—Announcement on Issuing the Revised Measures of the Customs of the People's Republic of China for the Administration of Origin of Goods Imported and Exported under the Free Trade Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of New Zealand
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第32号（关于公布《中华人民共和国海关〈中华人民共和国政府和新西兰政府自由贸易协定〉项下经修订的进出口货物原产地管理办法》的公告）
rows.description: With the approval of the State Council, the "Protocol on the Upgrade of the Free Trade Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of New Zealand" officially came into effect from April 7, 2022. To correctly determine the origin of import and export goods under the "Free Trade Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of New Zealand", the General Administration of Customs has formulated the "Revised Measures for the Administration of the Origin of Import and Export Goods under the Free Trade Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of New Zealand", which is hereby announced and implemented from April 7, 2022.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 经国务院批准，《中华人民共和国政府与新西兰政府关于升级〈中华人民共和国政府与新西兰政府自由贸易协定〉的议定书》自2022年4月7日起正式实施。为正确确定《中华人民共和国政府和新西兰政府自由贸易协定》项下进出口货物原产地，海关总署制定了《中华人民共和国海关〈中华人民共和国政府和新西兰政府自由贸易协定〉项下经修订的进出口货物原产地管理办法》，现予以公布，自2022年4月7日起执行。
rows.documentation: CHN_93.海关总署关于公布《中华人民共和国海关〈中华人民共和国政府和新西兰政府自由贸易协定〉项下经修订的进出口货物原产地管理办法》的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 33 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs—Announcement on Adjusting the Format of Certificates of Origin under the China-South Korea Free Trade Agreement
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第33号（关于调整中国—韩国自贸协定项下原产地证书格式的公告）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Free Trade Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Korea" and the resolution of the Joint Committee, the limit of up to 20 items of the certificate of origin for import and export goods under the agreement is canceled, and the certificate format is implemented according to the attachment.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据《中华人民共和国政府和大韩民国政府自由贸易协定》有关规定和联合委员会决议，取消该协定项下进出口货物原产地证书商品项数上限20项的限制，证书格式按照附件执行。
rows.documentation: CHN_92.海关总署关于调整中国—韩国自贸协定项下原产地证书格式的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 34 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for Imported Wild Aquatic Products from Kenya
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第34号（关于进口肯尼亚野生水产品检验检疫要求的公告）
rows.description: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of China and the "Agreement on the Inspection, Quarantine, and Veterinary Sanitary Requirements for the Export of Wild Aquatic Products from the Republic of Kenya to China" between the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries, and Cooperatives of the Republic of Kenya, starting from the date of publication of this announcement, the import of wild aquatic products from Kenya that meet the relevant requirements is allowed. The "Import Inspection and Quarantine Requirements for Wild Aquatic Products from Kenya" (see attachment) are hereby announced.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与肯尼亚共和国农业、畜牧业、渔业和合作部关于肯尼亚输华野生水产品的检验检疫和兽医卫生要求议定书》规定，自本公告发布之日起，允许符合相关要求的肯尼亚野生水产品进口。现将《进口肯尼亚野生水产品检验检疫要求》（见附件）予以公布。
rows.documentation: CHN_91.海关总署关于进口肯尼亚野生水产品检验检疫要求的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 38 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of sheeppox and goatpox from Mongolia to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第38号（关于防止蒙古绵羊痘和山羊痘传入我国的公告）
rows.description: On April 23, 2022, Mongolia urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that from April 11 to 12, sheeppox and goatpox occurred in one farm each in Hentiy Province, Dornod Province, and Sükhbaatar Province, involving 2747 sheep, among which 95 were sick and 13 died. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2022年4月23日，蒙古向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，4月11日至12日，该国肯特省（Hentiy）、东方省（Dornod）、苏赫巴托尔省（Sühbaatar）各1家农场发生绵羊痘和山羊痘，涉及2747只绵羊，其中95只发病，死亡13只。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.agencies: General Administration of Customs and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
rows.documentation: CHN_87.海关总署 农业农村部关于防止蒙古绵羊痘和山羊痘传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 40 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of cholera epidemic to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第40号（关于防止霍乱疫情传入我国的公告）
rows.description: According to the notification from the World Health Organization (WHO), there were outbreaks of cholera in Malawi, Benin, and Cameroon. To prevent the spread of the cholera epidemic in Malawi, Benin, and Cameroon to our country and to protect the health and safety of people entering and exiting the country, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Frontier Health and Quarantine" and its implementation rules and other relevant laws and regulations.

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 201 [2018] of the General Administration of Customs—Announcement on Issuing the Laboratory Test Methods of the Customs of the People's Republic of China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2018年第201号—关于发布中华人民共和国海关化验方法的公告
rows.description:
In accordance with the Measures of the Customs of the People's Republic of China for Laboratory Tests (Order No. 176, GACC), the General Administration of China (“GACC”) has decided to issue 133 items of Laboratory Test Methods of the Customs of the People's Republic of China (Annex 1) including CCLM1001-0001, on the basis of maintaining and updating the Laboratory Methods of the Customs of the People's Republic of China issued by Announcement No. 79 [2014] of the GACC. 
In order to facilitate the search and use, this Announcement is attached with the Catalogue of the Laboratory Test Methods of the Customs of the People's Republic of China (Annex 2) and the “Index of the Laboratory Test Methods for Certain Tariff Lines under the Customs Import and Export Tariff of the People's Republic of China (Annex 3). 
Where, in a laboratory test of attributes of a product, testing results obtained under a laboratory test method listed in this Announcement are inconsistent with those obtained under other laboratory test methods, the Customs' findings obtained under a laboratory test method listed in this Announcement shall be used as the basis for the Customs' law enforcement. 
This Announcement shall come into force on January 1, 2019, upon which Announcement No. 79 [2014] of the GACC shall be repealed.
rows.descriptionOriginal:
根据《中华人民共和国海关化验管理办法》（海关总署令第176号），海关总署决定，在对海关总署2014年第79号公告发布的“中华人民共和国海关化验方法”进行维护和更新的基础上，发布CCLM 1001-0001等133项“中华人民共和国海关化验方法”（附件1）。

　　为方便查找和使用，本公告附有“中华人民共和国海关化验方法”目录（附件2）和“《中华人民共和国海关进出口税则》部分税目化验方法索引”（附件3）。

　　对同一商品进行属性化验时，如公告所列化验方法与其他化验方法的检验结果不同时，以公告发布化验方法的海关检验结论作为海关执法依据。

　　本公告自2019年1月1日起执行。海关总署2014年第79号公告同时废止。

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 65 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the monkeypox epidemic from spreading to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2022年第65号（关于防止猴痘疫情传入我国的公告）
rows.description: According to the notification from the World Health Organization (WHO), this year more than 16,000 monkeypox cases have been reported in 75 countries, and WHO has declared the monkeypox outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. To prevent the spread of the monkeypox epidemic to our country and to protect the health and safety of people entering and exiting the country, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Frontier Health and Quarantine" and its implementation rules and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据世界卫生组织（WHO）通报，今年已有75个国家报告了超过16000例猴痘病例，WHO已宣布猴痘疫情为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。为防止猴痘疫情传入我国，保护出入境人员的健康安全，根据《中华人民共和国国境卫生检疫法》及其实施细则等法律法规的规定，现发布公告如下

rows.description: Based on the results of risk analysis, starting from the date of publication of this announcement, the ban on South African wool and the skin of even-toed animals in the 30th announcement jointly issued by the General Administration of Customs and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs in 2022 is lifted. Wool and the skin of even-toed animals imported from South Africa must meet the technical requirements for inactivating foot-and-mouth disease virus in the Terrestrial Animal Codex of the World Organization for Animal Health (WOAH) and the provisions of relevant laws and regulations of China.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据风险分析结果，自本公告发布之日起，解除海关总署、农业农村部联合发布的2022年第30号公告中对南非羊毛和偶蹄动物皮张的禁令。从南非进口的羊毛和偶蹄动物皮张须符合世界动物卫生组织（WOAH）陆生动物法典有关口蹄疫病毒灭活技术要求及我国相关法律法规规定。
rows.agencies: General Administration of Customs and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

rows.description: In order to facilitate the correct declaration of commodity classification matters by the consignors, consignees, and their agents of import and export goods, and to ensure the unification of customs commodity classification, the General Administration of Customs has formulated relevant commodity classification decisions according to the relevant provisions of the "Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of the Classification of Import and Export Goods" (promulgated by the GACC Order No. 252) (see Annex 1). At the same time, according to the actual situation of China's import and export commodities and international trade, some commodity classification opinions of the Harmonized System Committee of the World Customs Organization are transformed into commodity classification decisions (see Annex 2) and are hereby announced.

rows.officialTitle: REGULATION (EC) No 1013/2006 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 14 June 2006 on shipments of waste
rows.description:
Waste introduced into the territory of the European Union (EU) is subject to the control measures laid down by Regulation (EC) 1013/2006 (CELEX 32006R1013) which aim to improve environmental protection, and to reduce the risks to human health.

It also incorporates the provisions of the Basel Convention and the revision of the OECD’s 2001 decision on the control of transboundary movements of wastes destined for recovery operations in EU law.

This Regulation covers almost all types of waste with the exception of radioactive waste that is subject to a specific system of prior authorisation in order to provide greater protection against the dangers of ionising radiation, waste generated on board ships, shipments subject to the approval requirements of the animal by-product regulation, certain shipments of waste from the Antarctic, imports into the EU of certain waste generated by armed forces or relief organisations in situations of crisis, etc.

rows.officialTitle: Therapeutic Goods (Poisons Standard—February 2024) Instrument 2024
rows.description:
This instrument is made under paragraph 52D(2)(b) of the Therapeutic Goods Act 1989 (the Act), and is a compilation of decisions made under section 52D of the Act. This instrument should be read in conjunction with the Scheduling Policy Framework (the SPF) of the Australian Health Ministers’ Advisory Council. Further information on the scheduling amendments and the SPF can be viewed on the Therapeutic Goods Administration’s website (www.tga.gov.au). Refer to section 6 for definitions of specific terms used in this document including “medicine” and “poison” (noting that the definition of poison includes medicine).

This instrument serves 2 key purposes.

Firstly, this instrument contains the decisions of the Secretary of the Department of Health and Aged Care or the Secretary’s delegates regarding the classification of poisons into Schedules, as recommendations to Australian States and Territories. The scheduling classification sets the level of control on the availability of poisons. The scheduling of poisons is implemented through relevant State and Territory legislation. Certain advertising, labelling and packaging requirements may also be a consequence of scheduling, but are the subject of other Commonwealth registration schemes.

Secondly, this instrument includes provisions for labelling, containers, storage, disposal, record‑keeping, supply and possession of poisons in general which are intended to be adopted for use in each jurisdiction of Australia. Other government agencies may also impose controls on certain products.

The requirements for labelling and containers in this instrument are intended to integrate with existing legislative instruments for labelling and containers. Advertising, labelling and packaging of therapeutic goods and agricultural and veterinary chemicals are also dealt with through the respective product registration schemes provided for in Commonwealth legislation.

Poisons which are packed and sold solely for industrial, manufacturing, laboratory or dispensary use are exempt from all labelling requirements included in this instrument as they are covered by labelling requirements under applicable jurisdictional Work Health and Safety laws, as amended from time to time. Note, however that this exemption does not extend to controls on supply of these poisons.

 (a) to establish a national system of units and standards of measurement of physical quantities; and

 (c) to co‑ordinate the operation of the national system of measurement; and

 (d) to bring about the use of the metric system of measurement in Australia as the sole system of measurement of physical quantities; and

 (e) to provide for a national system of trade measurement;

and this Act shall be construed accordingly.

 (1A) Subsection (2) does not apply in respect of the application of this Act and regulations to utility meters used for trade.

Note: Section 4A deals with the application of the Act in respect of utility meters used for trade

rows.officialTitle: National Environmental (Chemicals and Pesticides) Regulations, 2023
rows.description: These Regulations, made under provisions of section 34 of the National Environmental Standards and Regulations Enforcement Agency (Establishment) (Amendment) Act 2007, apply to: restricted or banned chemicals and pesticides; storage, usage, and marketing of chemicals, pesticides and other agrochemicals; import and export of these substances; manufacture and import, of Mercury-Added Products (MAPs) and paints. The objectives of these Regulations are: protecting human health and environment from the harmful effect of chemicals, pesticides and other agrochemicals; contributing to the sustainable development of agriculture and the conservation of the environment; ensuring an Environmentally Sound Management (ESM) of chemical and pesticides within their life cycle for the protection of human health and environment; supporting and strengthening the implementation of chemicals related international conventions and agreements; enforcing the Rotterdam Convention on the Prior Informed Consent (PIC) procedure for certain hazardous chemicals and pesticides in international trade; enforcing the ban on Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs); controlling the transboundary movement of chemicals, pesticides, agrochemicals, wastes and their disposal; minimising pollution arising from the manufacture, use and disposal of Mercury-added products, and enforcing ban on these products; reducing Mercury emissions; promoting public information and education on Mercury hazards; eliminating the use of paints and coatings containing added lead compounds; providing standardised warning labels for all paints and other coating products to better inform consumers and workers of the hazards of lead exposure from paint products; preventing and reducing adverse effects of chemicals and pesticides.
rows.agencies: National Environmental Standards and Regulations Enforcement Agency (NESREA)

rows.officialTitle: National Environmental (Food, Beverages and Tobacco Sector) Regulations, 2009

The Regulations require companies to submit Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) for new industries and major developmental projects before commencement of operations. The Regulations also task companies to reduce the amount of packaging material and implement the reuse, recovery and recycling of packaging materials. Furthermore, companies are tasked to install anti-pollution equipment to detoxify effluent and emissions emanating from their operations. The Regulations provides for the application of the Polluter-pays principle

rows.officialTitle: Nigerian Nuclear Safeguards Regulations, 2021
rows.description:
The purpose of these Regulations is to establish a System of Accounting and Control (SAC) for nuclear material, as implemented by the Authority. This system is intended to ensure the timely detection of any loss, theft, diversion, or unauthorized production or possession of nuclear material.

In addition, the Regulations aim to facilitate the effective implementation of the Safeguards Agreement and the Additional Protocol between the Federal Republic of Nigeria and the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). This includes establishing clear requirements and procedures for the accountancy and control of nuclear materials, submission of design information for relevant facilities, and the provision of all necessary information as required under both the Safeguards Agreement and Additional Protocol, including support for national inspections.

Finally, these Regulations provide a framework for Nigeria to fulfill its international obligations under the Safeguards Agreement and the relevant provisions outlined in Annex II of the Additional Protocol

rows.officialTitle: Food  Fortification Regulations, 2021
rows.description: These Regulations concern fortified foods manufactured, imported, exported, distributed, advertised, sold or used in Nigeria. It introduces prohibitions regarding the placing on the market of fortified foods and prescribe rules regarding labelling of such foods.

rows.officialTitle: Food Additives Regulations, 2021
rows.description: These Regulations require food additives manufactured, imported, exported, distributed, advertised, displayed for sale or used in Nigeria to be food additives meeting prescribed standards. The Regulations also apply to food processing aids and any reference to food additives shall include food processing aids. Food additive shall be incorporated in the food in a quantity within the limits prescribed for such food and food additive in the National Standards for the particular food and Codex standards where applicable and as prescribed by the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC).
rows.source: National Agency for Food & Drug Administration and Control
rows.agencies: National Agency for Food & Drug Administration and Control

rows.officialTitle: Food Grade (Table or Cooking) Salt Regulations, 2021
rows.description: These Regulations of the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) require any salt, used as an ingredient of food for direct use by consumers, food manufacturers or as a carrier of food additive to meet the standard requirements for food grade salt as set out in these Regulations

rows.officialTitle: Milk and Dairy Products Regulations, 2021
rows.description: This regulation by the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) mandates that milk and dairy products must be registered with the Agency before they can be manufactured, imported, exported, advertised, sold, or distributed in Nigeria, and also sets requirements for labeling, permissible food additives, and product composition standards
rows.source: National Agency for Food & Drug Administration and Control
rows.agencies: National Agency for Food & Drug Administration and Control

rows.officialTitle: Non-Nutritive Sweeteners in Drug Products (Prohibition) Regulations, 2021
rows.description: These Regulations, made by the Governing Council of the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC), prohibit the manufacture, import, export, advertisement, sale, distribution of any drug product which contains non-nutritive sweeteners, except as provided for in these Regulations. Also, no person shall manufacture, trade in or place on the market a product which contains non-nutritive sweeteners which are recognised as novel excipients, i.e. any substance which is used as an excipient to impart sweetness for the first time in a drug product, or by a new route of administration. NAFDAC may authorise the manufacture, importation, exportation, sale, distribution, advertisement and use of registered or permitted non-nutritive sweeteners for special dietary requirements and drug formulations. A drug product shall be deemed as adulterated and hazardous to health, if it contains non-nutritive sweeteners not permitted by the Agency.
rows.source: National Agency for Food & Drug Administration and Control

rows.officialTitle: (Voluntary) EU Ecolabel for animal care products
rows.description:
The EU Ecolabel or 'Flower logo' is the official mark in the European Union (EU) for products with the lowest
environmental impact in a product range. Its aim is to promote, as well as to help consumers to identify those products
which contribute significantly to improvements in relation to key environmental aspects.
Participation on the scheme is voluntary. This means that products can be sold within the EU market without the
Flower logo and that there are no regulations which oblige to apply for the Ecolabel.

rows.officialTitle: Marketing standards for fresh fruit and vegetables for Israel
rows.description:
Imports into the European Union (EU) of fruits and vegetables must comply with the EU-harmonised marketing standards: Regulation (EC) 543/2011 (CELEX 32011R0543) replaced with Regulation (EU) 2023/2429

The European Commission may approve conformity checking operations performed in the country of origin by the competent authorities. In this case, prior to the entry into the EU, the Israeli inspection bodies must check each lot of goods and draw up the certificate of conformity agreed between the EU Commission and Israel.

rows.officialTitle: REGULATION (EC) No 1013/2006 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 14 June 2006 on shipments of waste
rows.description:
Waste introduced into the territory of the European Union (EU) is subject to the control measures laid down by Regulation (EC) 1013/2006 (CELEX 32006R1013) which aim to improve environmental protection, and to reduce the risks to human health.

It also incorporates the provisions of the Basel Convention and the revision of the OECD’s 2001 decision on the control of transboundary movements of wastes destined for recovery operations in EU law.

This Regulation covers almost all types of waste with the exception of radioactive waste that is subject to a specific system of prior authorisation in order to provide greater protection against the dangers of ionising radiation, waste generated on board ships, shipments subject to the approval requirements of the animal by-product regulation, certain shipments of waste from the Antarctic, imports into the EU of certain waste generated by armed forces or relief organisations in situations of crisis, etc.

rows.officialTitle: REGULATION (EC) No 1013/2006 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 14 June 2006 on shipments of waste
rows.description:
Waste introduced into the territory of the European Union (EU) is subject to the control measures laid down by Regulation (EC) 1013/2006 (CELEX 32006R1013) which aim to improve environmental protection, and to reduce the risks to human health.

It also incorporates the provisions of the Basel Convention and the revision of the OECD’s 2001 decision on the control of transboundary movements of wastes destined for recovery operations in EU law.

This Regulation covers almost all types of waste with the exception of radioactive waste that is subject to a specific system of prior authorisation in order to provide greater protection against the dangers of ionising radiation, waste generated on board ships, shipments subject to the approval requirements of the animal by-product regulation, certain shipments of waste from the Antarctic, imports into the EU of certain waste generated by armed forces or relief organisations in situations of crisis, etc.

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 103 [2023] of the General Administration of Customs - Announcement on Completely Suspending the IMPORT of Aquatic Products from Japan
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署公告2023年第103号（关于全面暂停进口日本水产品的公告）
rows.description: In order to comprehensively prevent the radioactive contamination risks to food safety caused by the discharge of nuclear contaminated water from Fukushima, Japan, protect the health of Chinese consumers, and ensure the safety of imported food, the General Administration of Customs has decided to fully suspend the import of aquatic products (including edible aquatic animals) originating from Japan, effective from August 24, 2023 (inclusive). This decision is based on the relevant provisions of the Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China and its implementation regulations, the Administrative Measures for the Import and Export Food Safety of the People's Republic of China, and the relevant provisions of the World Trade Organization's Agreement on the Application of Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 为全面防范日本福岛核污染水排海对食品安全造成的放射性污染风险，保护中国消费者健康，确保进口食品安全，依据《中华人民共和国食品安全法》及其实施条例、《中华人民共和国进出口食品安全管理办法》有关规定，以及世界贸易组织《实施卫生与植物卫生措施协定》有关规定，海关总署决定自2023年8月24日（含）起全面暂停进口原产地为日本的水产品（含食用水生动物）。

The plant quarantine requirements for imported fresh melons from Brazil are now announced.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 根据我国相关法律法规和《中华人民共和国海关总署与巴西联邦共和国农业、畜牧和食品供应部关于巴西甜瓜输华植物检疫要求的议定书》规定，自本公告发布之日起，允许符合相关要求的巴西甜瓜进口。现将进口巴西鲜食甜瓜植物检疫要求予以公布。

rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第5号（关于防止巴勒斯坦口蹄疫传入我国的公告）
rows.description: On December 15, 2021, Palestine urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) that a foot-and-mouth disease outbreak occurred at a farm in Tubas province, West Bank region, involving 172 susceptible animals, goats, and sheep, among which 40 were sick and 5 died. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2021年12月15日，巴勒斯坦向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国约旦河西岸地区图巴斯省的1家农场发生口蹄疫疫情，血清型待鉴定。涉及的易感动物为172只山羊和绵羊，其中40只发病，5只死亡。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.agencies: General Administration of Customs and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
rows.documentation: CHN_119.海关总署 农业农村部关于防止巴勒斯坦口蹄疫传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 9 [2022] of the General Administration of Customs-Announcement on preventing the spread of African swine fever from Italy and North Macedonia to China
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2022年第9号（关于防止意大利、北马其顿非洲猪瘟传入我国的公告）
rows.description: On January 8, 2022, Italy urgently reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) an African Swine Fever incident on January 5 in Alessandria, Piedmont, involving a susceptible animal, a wild boar, which became ill and died. On January 10, 2022, North Macedonia urgently reported to the OIE an African Swine Fever outbreak on December 29, 2021, in the Delčevo region, involving 18 susceptible domestic pigs, among which 3 were sick and 15 died. To protect the safety of China's animal husbandry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, the following announcement is made in accordance with the provisions of the "Customs Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine" and its implementation regulations, and other relevant laws and regulations.
rows.descriptionOriginal: 2022年1月8日，意大利向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国皮埃蒙特大区亚历山德里亚省（Alessandria，Piemonte）1月5日发生1起非洲猪瘟，涉及易感动物为野猪，1头野猪发病死亡。2022年1月10日，北马其顿向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急报告，该国代尔切沃地区（Delčevo）2021年12月29日发生1起非洲猪瘟，涉及易感动物为18头家猪，其中3头发病，15头死亡。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》及其实施条例等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下
rows.agencies: General Administration of Customs and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
rows.documentation: CHN_115.海关总署 农业农村部关于防止意大利、北马其顿非洲猪瘟传入我国的公告.pdf

rows.officialTitle: Announcement No. 99, 2018 of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the General Administration of Customs (Announcement on Preventing the Introduction of Bulgarian PPR into Our Country)
rows.officialTitleOriginal: 海关总署 农业农村部公告2018年第99号（关于防止保加利亚小反刍兽疫传入我国的公告）
rows.description: The Bulgarian Ministry of Agriculture and Food has urgently notified the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) of an outbreak of PPR involving 160 goats and 380 sheep in Jambol Prefecture. The diagnosis is laboratory tested and is the first of its kind in Bulgaria. In order to protect the safety of our country's animal husbandry industry and prevent the spread of the epidemic, in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Animal and Plant Quarantine and other relevant laws and regulations, the following announcement is hereby made:
rows.descriptionOriginal: 近日，保加利亚农业和食品部向世界动物卫生组织（OIE）紧急通报，扬博尔州（Jambol）发生1起小反刍兽疫疫情，涉及160只山羊和380只绵羊，诊断性质为实验室检测，此次疫情为保加利亚首次发生。为保护我国畜牧业安全，防止疫情传入，根据《中华人民共和国进出境动植物检疫法》等有关法律法规的规定，现公告如下：
rows.agencies: The General Administration of Customs, The Ministry of Agriculture and Rual Areas

rows.officialTitle: General Administration of Customs — Announcement on Carrying Out Random Inspection of Import and Export Commodities Outside the Catalogue of Commodities Subject to Statutory Inspection
rows.description:
To protect the legitimate rights and interests of consumers and safeguard the lives, health, and safety of the people, and in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Import and Export Commodity Inspection" and its implementing regulations, the General Administration of Customs has decided to implement spot checks on certain import and export commodities outside the statutory inspection catalogue, effective from the date of this announcement. The scope of these spot checks is attached.

　　The random inspection and testing work shall be carried out in accordance with the "Administrative Measures for Random Inspection and Testing of Import and Export Commodities" (promulgated by Order No. 39 of the former General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and revised by Order No. 263 of the General Administration of Customs).

　　After the release of this announcement, General Administration of Customs Announcement No. 132 of 2019, No. 95 of 2020, No. 60 of 2021 and No. 60 of 2022 will be repealed.
